title: Enablement Concierge: QuickOps kit for Edge Routing + Fallback Launch
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Deliver a compact, high-signal enablement kit ("QuickOps") for Sales and CS ahead of the Edge Routing + Fallback v2 release. The kit should let AE/SEs run a 10–15 minute demo, answer top objections, and prescribe configuration patterns for common customer scenarios (multi-region latency, cost-driven fallback, private deployment concerns).

Scope: one-page battlecard, concise FAQ, two talk-track variations (technical and executive), a live demo script (+ optional checklist for hands-off recorded demo), an updated release notes summary for GTM, email/slide templates for enablement sessions, and a post-launch playbook for incident handoffs.

Success metrics: enablement session NPS >= 7, first-touch demo conversion lift measured qualitatively by Sales leads, and fewer than 3 escalation tickets per 100 early-adopter accounts in first 30 days.

Stakeholders and owners:
- PM (owner): Asha Kapoor
- Sales Enablement lead: Owen Kim (review/rollout)
- SE/Demo owner: Diego Morales (assignee)
- Documentation: Priya Nair (Docs) — release notes sync
- Design: Lena Park — battlecard visuals and one-pager layout
- Engineering contacts: Maya Singh (runtime), Tom Ellis (SRE) — accuracy checks
- Legal/compliance: Marcus Holt — quick scan for customer claims

Distribution channels: Redwood Console release notes banner, email to Sales & CS, Slack enablement channel (#enablement-sales), Confluence enablement page, Drive folder with assets, and an on-demand Loom recording linked from the Confluence page.
tasks: Battlecard one-pager: key value props, typical customer scenarios, pricing/latency talking points
Concise FAQ (top 12 questions) with short answers and links to deeper docs
Two talk tracks: technical SE flow and executive business flow (each ~8 bullets)
Live demo script: 12-minute guided demo focusing on routing policy, fallback behavior, and troubleshooting steps
Recorded demo: SE records a walk-through and uploads to Drive for on-demand playback
Release notes GTM summary: 2-paragraph abstract + bulleted customer-facing changes for Sales scripts
Email + slide templates for a 30-minute enablement session
Post-launch playbook: triage flow, escalation contacts, and rollback/fallback guidance
Customer onboarding checklist for CS with config knobs and sample prompts
Tracking doc: enablement attendance, feedback form link, and follow-up action tracker
acceptance_criteria: Battlecard reviewed and approved by Sales lead (Owen Kim) and SE owner (Diego Morales)
FAQ validated with Eng (Maya Singh) and SRE (Tom Ellis)
Demo script dry-run completed with at least two SEs and recorded
Release notes blurb signed off by Docs and Legal
Assets uploaded to Drive + Confluence with permalinks included in the ticket
Enablement session scheduled and calendar invites created for Sales & CS
